messages:
Ishaan (PM): Quick decision needed: adopt a Quarantine + Overlap-Guard pattern for the upcoming model-routing launch. Short answers pls.

Mei (Eng): Describe Quarantine?

Ishaan (PM): Quarantine = isolate newly opted tenants into a protected cohort with stricter quotas, banned cross-experiment overlap, and mandatory extra telemetry. Goal = let sales opt in clients with minimal blast radius.

Jordan (SRE): Need concrete thresholds. Propose: quota burst < 25% of normal, fallback_threshold = 10 invocations/min, auto-kill if p95 > 500ms for 3m.

Mei (Eng): We can enforce via routing layer tokens_per_min bucket + `overlap_guard` flag. If overlap detected, admin API rejects activation.

Asha (Product Ops): Rollout sequence idea: 1) Quarantine seed (5 tenants, 48h), 2) Quarantine ramp (20 tenants, +7d), 3) General availability. Each step requires Eng+SRE sign-off.

Ben (Sales): Sales needs per-tenant scheduling windows and a contact for paging during seed. I'll collect opt-in list.

Mei (Eng): Fallback tiers planned: small_quant model -> soft rate-limit (10% shed) -> tenant isolation. We'll emit `fallback_reason` and `quarantine_state` in telemetry.

Jordan (SRE): Add alerts: 1) quarantine_fallbacks > 20/min -> page, 2) per-tenant p95 > 400ms over baseline -> page. Also test kill-switch in preflight.

Ishaan (PM): A/B plan: only show experimental behavior to 15% of quarantine cohort. UI controlled by client-side sampling flag. Non-participants see unchanged flows.

Mei (Eng): Flag schema (abbreviated): `flag: quarantine_routing_v1; scope: tenant; quarantine_pct: 100; ab_sample: 15; overlap_guard: true; fallbacks: [small_quant, soft_limit]`.

Asha (Product Ops): Preflight checklist items: flag created, dashboard ready, kill-switch tested, partner comms sent. I'll publish checklist and dashboard link.

Ben (Sales): I'll nominate Acme-Intl and Nova as seed tenants and handle EU data residency asks.

status-bot: deploy window proposed 2026-04-12 03:00 UTC (quarantine seed). Preflight T-4h.

Ishaan (PM): Owners: Mei (eng), Jordan (SRE), Asha (ops), Ben (sales). React with :white_check_mark: if you accept.
